description: This file defines the HttpPushClientActor class, a Java Actor responsible for managing HTTP push connections, including connection testing, resource management, and proxy handling in an Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: HttpPushClientActor
classes.description: Actor class managing HTTP push connections including setup, testing, and proxy handling.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Factory method to create Props for HttpPushClientActor.

methods.name: canConnectViaSocket
methods.description: Checks if connection via socket is possible, considering proxy configuration.

methods.name: doTestConnection
methods.description: Performs a test of the connection, including SSL/tCP connection and proxy checks.

methods.name: allocateResourcesOnConnection
methods.description: Allocates resources once a connection is established; no additional resources in this implementation.

methods.name: cleanupResourcesForConnection
methods.description: Cleans up resources, such as stopping child actors.

methods.name: getPublisherActor
methods.description: Returns the actor responsible for publishing messages.

methods.name: testSSL
methods.description: Performs SSL handshake to verify SSL connection.

methods.name: connectViaProxy
methods.description: Establishes a connection through an HTTP proxy.

methods.name: checkProxyConnection
methods.description: Checks if the proxy connection was successful by reading the response.

methods.name: statusSuccessFuture
methods.description: Creates a completed future indicating success.

methods.name: statusFailureFuture
methods.description: Creates a completed future indicating failure with an error.
